other_subtypes.Review: Required evidence is missing, unresolved, or fails a shared admission check.
other_subtypes.Sequence: Nested protein without independent support, >=95% Unsafe 9-mer containment, or a read-through locus whose every coding transcript joins two separate genes.
other_subtypes.Expression: Neither positive expression route qualifies, or the target maximum or Disposable cap fails.
other_subtypes.Tissue: The protein's recorded normal home is a tissue no expression panel resolves, and no reproductive or developmental evidence qualifies. Its tumor value was never compared with that tissue, so cancer evidence alone does not admit it.

home_tissue.recorded_by: A family rule, a recorded literature finding, or the nose and skin reference.
home_tissue.effect: Without qualifying reproductive or developmental evidence: Other:Tissue. With it, the category is unchanged and the tissue stays on the row.

published_normal_expression.scope: Every Target candidate of the previous catalog and every rare-cell dependent.
published_normal_expression.exclude: A gene-specific report in normal adult tissue that the tissue-tier registry or its updates tier Vital or Protected, with a quote retrieved from the source. Unsafe.
published_normal_expression.recorded: Confirmed findings that do not meet the rubric, and family rules by protein name, keep their tissue and tier on the row. The only category effect is the home-tissue rule.

expression_bounds.target_maximum: max(tumor, adult reproductive, developmental) >= 1 and above every measured nonreproductive normal and Disposable value on the comparison scale.
expression_bounds.cap_scope: Each source scale separately; a screening convention, not a tolerance.

rare_cell_rna.unit: One adult donor x one named Vital or Protected cell population, UMI counts
rare_cell_rna.signal: >= 1% of a donor's cells and >= 10 cells carry >= 2 molecules.
rare_cell_rna.replication: The signal in >= 2 independent studies of the same organ, which agree on a cell type or include >= 3 donors. Donors of one study share its libraries and reference; one donor in each of two studies, in different cell types, agrees on nothing but the organ.
rare_cell_rna.single_study: Without replication, a signal counts only when >= 5% of a donor's cells carry multiple molecules.
rare_cell_rna.protected: Protected populations need 2 times these frequencies.
rare_cell_rna.single_molecules: Single-molecule detection alone does not establish expression. Ambient RNA and read assignment are possible confounders, not demonstrated explanations.
rare_cell_rna.mapping_risk: Shared transcript sequence with another locus, or an exon inside another same-strand gene. Attribution needs read-level review; a flag does not prove artifact.
rare_cell_rna.confirmation: Bulk RNA >= 1 native TPM in the same organ in both the HPA and GTEx sample sets, a different assay with its own read assignment.
rare_cell_rna.established: A replicated signal at a locus without mapping risk, or any signal with bulk confirmation. Unsafe.
rare_cell_rna.dismissed: A weak or inconsistent signal below replication and frequency requirements. Recorded with its reason; no category effect.
rare_cell_rna.unresolved: A replicated signal with unresolved locus attribution, or a frequent single-study signal without independent confirmation. Other:Review pending adjudication.
rare_cell_rna.literature: Where a reviewed publication reports the gene in the same organ by a gene-specific assay, 1% detection in one donor is established, single molecules included: two assay types then agree. Published protein in a Vital or Protected tissue excludes through the knowledge layer without any counts.

consequences.unresolved: Other:Review; strong evidence needs attribution or confirmation.
consequences.dismissed: No finding; the reason and counts stay in the record.
consequences.below_screen: No finding. Not a demonstration of absence or safety.
consequences.unassessed: Recorded as unmeasured; never treated as negative.

rare_cell_rna.interpretation: Detection frequency measures captured RNA, not the fraction of cells producing protein. No cutoff is a calibrated toxicity threshold.

cancer_rna.rule: T >= 10 * max(N, D, 1) in at least one qualified tumor sample of any comparable TPM cohort. N is the highest non-reproductive normal value, D the highest Disposable value. This is the only cancer route.
cancer_rna.normal_reference: N: maximum QC-passing, identity-resolved measurement in the declared compatible normal panel, excluding Disposable and reproductive compartments. D is taken separately; reproductive, placental and fetal compartments are never compared.
cancer_rna.descriptive: Counts at the actual tenfold threshold distinguish samples, known patients, anonymous samples and cancer types. Above-normal counts are legacy descriptors.

excluded_tumors.reason: No histology is excluded wholesale. TGCT libraries that pass the coordinated spermatid-program screen may supply cancer evidence.

cancer_rna.comparability: One documented comparison scale and complete required normal contexts. Equal unit names alone do not establish comparability. No TPM/nTPM/pTPM/CP10K pooling.
cancer_rna.protein: Independent annotation; qualitative staining cannot satisfy a numerical RNA fold.

reproductive_evidence.rule: R >= 10 * max(N, D, 1), using the identical normal panel and comparison scale as CA.
reproductive_evidence.bulk: At least one QC-passing, identity-resolved reproductive tissue sample on the declared comparison scale.
reproductive_evidence.cell: Cell-type nTPM and UMI counts remain separate annotations and normal checks; no unit pooling.
reproductive_evidence.developmental: Mean native TPM within one embryo and lineage. One well-sampled population: >=20 cells, >=5 cells and >=10% cells at >=1 TPM. Smaller populations: >=5 measured cells, >=50% at >=1 TPM, and >=2 independent embryos at the same age and lineage reaching the fold. The mean must reach the tenfold threshold; higher fold filters retain replication. Embryos are biological donors; cells are not independent witnesses.
reproductive_evidence.protein: Reliable reproductive IHC and reviewed protein findings annotate association; they cannot bypass the RNA fold.
reproductive_evidence.concentration: The same tenfold enrichment requirement as CA, assessed independently.

compartments.lactating_breast_rule: Individual breast biopsy samples with coordinated milk-protein RNA (>= 3 of LALBA, CSN1S1, CSN2, CSN3 at >= 100 native TPM) are assigned to lactating_breast (inferred secretory signature). Complete panels without that signature retain the legacy resting_breast label; incomplete marker coverage stays unknown. These are not provider-confirmed physiological states.
compartments.cta_tier_interpretation: Legacy origin/exposure annotation retained for compatibility, not a toxicity tier or host eligibility rule. Use reproductive_qualifying_compartments for origins and HostContext for host choices.

cta_tiers.core: Qualifies in embryo, placenta, testis or ovary, with all eight extended adult compartments <= 32 TPM and <= tumor_max_tpm / 10.
cta_tiers.core_with_extended_exposure: Qualifies in embryo, placenta, testis or ovary, and also exceeds 32 TPM or lacks a 10x tumor margin in an extended adult compartment.
cta_tiers.extended_only: Qualifies only via epididymis, prostate, seminal vesicle, fallopian tube, endometrium, cervix, lactating_breast or resting_breast.

shared_normal_policy.scope: Normal assessment only; legacy cancer, reproductive and concentration gates excluded.
shared_normal_policy.allowances: Same resolved reproductive and Disposable compartment allowances for both sets. Immune, endothelial and other protected cells do not inherit an organ's allowance.
shared_normal_policy.threshold_interpretation: RNA/IHC cutoffs are screening conventions, not measured injury thresholds. Negative IHC does not establish a calibrated safety margin.

translation: Qualifying coding reference or supported noncanonical ORF plus complete approved MANE-first/canonical representative; resolve conflicting coding evidence. Experimental protein detection is retained separately.
published_target_support: Positive evidence annotation for a curated, exact-scope target nomination. Preserve every protein-paper link and its attested claim; biology or background-table coverage alone is not a target nomination. Publication cannot override an exclusion or hold.
only_meaning: Membership in one qualified set, not proven absence from the other context.
